translations.web: The heavens are Yahweh’s heavens, but he has given the earth to the children of men.
translations.bsb: The highest heavens belong to the LORD, but the earth He has given to mankind.
translations.kjv: The heaven, even the heavens, are the LORD'S: but the earth hath he given to the children of men.
translations.asv: The heavens are the heavens of Jehovah; But the earth hath he given to the children of men.
